import sqlite3, os, textwrap
sql = textwrap.dedent('''
WITH country_genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        CAST(SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100.0, 0) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS INTEGER) AS revenue_cents,
        CAST(SUM(il.Quantity) AS INTEGER) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
      ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t
      ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g
      ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        i.BillingCountry,
        t.GenreId,
        g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM country_genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country AS country,
    genre_id AS genre_id,
    genre AS genre,
    revenue_cents AS revenue_cents,
    units AS units,
    country_rank AS country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
''').strip() + '\n'

out_path='/work/query.sql'
with open(out_path,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(sql)
print('wrote', out_path, 'bytes', os.path.getsize(out_path))

con=sqlite3.connect('/inputs/Chinook.sqlite')
cur=con.cursor()
cur.execute(sql)
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('row_count', len(rows))
print('columns', [d[0] for d in cur.description])
print('first_rows', rows[:5])
